provenance.artifact_title: Plan noise vs plan-first prompting for code
provenance.task_id_mapping_confirmed_against: sibling artifacts in the same run repeatedly name T03=kth smallest, T10=connected components, T2=shortest path, T05=two sum, T1=grid (e.g. gen_art_experiment_19, _20, _39, _50 in the same run family)
provenance.committed_verdict_in_source: DISCONFIRMED: plan noise's H5 matches or beats the best text sampler on only 1 of 5 decisive tasks (kth smallest), below the pre-registered threshold of 3/5; task-level bootstrap win probabilities (p_PN_ge_best_text) are 0.582 (kth smallest, flagged unresolved), 0.0 (connected components), 0.059 (shortest path), 0.0135 (two sum), 0.3775 (grid, flagged unresolved).
provenance.known_sensitivity_not_redrawn_here: A later experiment in the same run (gen_art_experiment_36, iteration 7, run_0oWBKrKEGsmU) re-priced plan noise under a different noise-dose convention carried over from an earlier iteration and found a similar disconfirming outcome (plan noise beats base intent on 2 of 5 tasks there, still below the 3/5 threshold) with different point values on 3 of the 5 tasks; this figure plots the comparison's own iteration-5 engine/dose, not that alternative convention, and the summary field of this run's output records the sensitivity rather than blending the two into one set of bars.
